query: How does resolution duration vary across incident category and priority?

per_column.name: resolution_hours
per_column.rationale: This is the core dependent variable the query asks about; resolution duration is exactly what must vary across category and priority. Derivable from opened_at and closed_at, which are present. Values are plausible (24.6h, 47.9h, etc.) and consistent with typical incident spans.

per_column.name: duration_band
per_column.rationale: A short/medium/long categorization of resolution_hours gives a clean grouping axis useful for cross-tabbing against category and priority. Somewhat redundant with resolution_hours but adds a usable discretization. Bands match the underlying hours (47.9h and 56.7h -> long, 24.6h -> medium).

per_column.name: duration_vs_category_median
per_column.rationale: Deviation of each incident's duration from its category median directly supports the 'across category' half of the query, normalizing for category baseline. Derived from resolution_hours grouped by the present category column; sample values track resolution_hours sensibly.

per_column.name: duration_vs_priority_median
per_column.rationale: Deviation from priority median directly supports the 'across priority' half of the query. Grounded in resolution_hours and the present priority column; values are consistent with the hours in the samples.

per_column.name: duration_z_score
per_column.rationale: A global standardization of duration is a mild new axis for outlier detection, but it is largely a monotone rescaling of resolution_hours and does not condition on category or priority, so it adds less leverage for THIS grouped query than the two median-deviation columns. Values are correctly derived from resolution_hours.

judge.rationale: The added columns are well targeted to the query: resolution_hours is the key measure, duration_band gives a grouping axis, and the two median-deviation columns are almost purpose-built for comparing duration across category and priority. All values are soundly derived from present fields (opened_at/closed_at, category, priority). The z-score is somewhat redundant with resolution_hours and does not condition on the grouping dimensions, slightly lowering the holistic usefulness, but it remains grounded and no hallucinations were observed.
